_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); analog semiconductor signals; the listing and short-history bounds rules (AVGO)

pit_profile.why: Broadcom: 'We are a global technology leader that designs, develops and supplies a broad range of semiconductor and infrastructure software solutions', 'We have two reportable segments: semiconductor solutions and infrastructure software', and 'We operate a primarily outsourced manufacturing business model' (its own FY2023 10-K); 'The markets in which we participate are highly competitive', and 'We operate in the highly cyclical semiconductor industry': a cyclical and competitive risk, not an obsolescence one

theme_watch.reason: Live: the company's own FY2023 10-K says 'the shift to cloud-based IT solutions and services, such as hyperscale computing, which may adversely affect the timing and volume of sales of our products for use in traditional enterprise data centers'. At the same time it sells into data centers itself: 'We offer a broad set of Ethernet switching and routing products that are optimized for data center, service provider and enterprise networks'. The stock trades at 38.9x FY24E — near its own median. Re-file as DISRUPTION_EXPOSED (CLOUD) only if dated evidence shows the market pricing cloud substitution of its enterprise storage and networking specifically.

classification.quality_note: Broadcom: 'We are a global technology leader that designs, develops and supplies a broad range of semiconductor and infrastructure software solutions', 'We have two reportable segments: semiconductor solutions and infrastructure software', and 'We operate a primarily outsourced manufacturing business model' (its own FY2023 10-K); 'The markets in which we participate are highly competitive', and 'We operate in the highly cyclical semiconductor industry': a cyclical and competitive risk, not an obsolescence one. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price cheap; Ratio B 0.49x; +69% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +0.90; conservative 2yr +43%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -2.0%/yr (worst year FY15-FY23 ex-FY16 ex-FY18, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +34.5%/yr (FY24 guide on FY23 + margin + buyback); P/E at its 9.3-yr ex-FY16 ex-FY18 median

BULL.desc: EPS +34.5%/yr (FY15-FY23 ex-FY16 ex-FY18 CAGR, at least BASE); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +104.7%/yr (best 2-yr run FY15-FY23 ex-FY16 ex-FY18, at least BULL); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: AVGO (retrospective, 2024-02-09) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.49x (53.1% downside to Bear $601.73 / +108.7% upside to Bull $2679.18) | Adj composite 2.62 vs market 1.73: gap +0.90 [UNDERVALUED] | +69% above the EPP floor $758.54 (23x FY24E $32.98) | Conservative 2-yr case: +43.2% total (+21.6%/yr) | At 38.9x FY24E the 15% hurdle price $1,697.35 sits at or below the BASE case; net revenue +4.1% YoY in Q4 FY23, forward revenues +39.6% (FY24 revenue guide (Q4 FY23 release)); cloud is live and company-acknowledged; no dated evidence ties the multiple to it.
